output.title: Single-namespace mode fix; leaderElection namespace key is set
output.content: The fix concerns running with `--namespace=<namespace>`, which limits scope to one namespace and disables cluster-scoped controllers. The environment sets `global.leaderElection.namespace`, but that is a different setting and does not show the flag is used. Inspect the cert-manager Deployment args for `--namespace` to decide whether this fix changes behavior. The arguments are not shown in the summary.
